scope: Specification only; controls not executed by this author. Apply each single mutation in a fresh private source copy and compile/run exactly the selected test. Require its intended assertion line after actual worker cleanup to fail. Compile errors, zero tests, unrelated failures, timeout and unchanged passing output reject a control. All barriers/backends/settings are local synthetic fixtures; no device, native timing or runtime quiescence proof.

controls.name: capacity-excludes-in-flight-reservation
controls.oracle: One blocked backend request occupies the entire bound. A second canonical creation must refuse Full. The fixture retains the erroneous result, requests stop, releases the backend and joins before this assertion; admitting the extra request is a functional failure, not a hang.

controls.name: generation-close-keeps-unsent-queue
controls.oracle: Generation close must clear two immutable unsent envelopes while the worker is paused. The fixture snapshots the resulting queue length, uses the independent terminal-stop cleanup, starts and joins the worker, then checks that generation close cleared it.

controls.name: terminal-stop-omits-terminal-admission-boundary
controls.oracle: A stop request on a full mailbox must permanently reject fresh-baseline adoption by a stale clone. The mutation merely closes the current generation, allowing a newer baseline to stage. The independently stopping join drains the paused worker before the stored result is checked.

controls.name: new-baseline-ignores-resolved-but-reserved-envelope
controls.oracle: A test-only one-shot barrier pauses after exact route ACK/settings completion but before mailbox reservation is cleared. Generation closure and a fresh epoch make the route independently eligible; the mailbox must still refuse Busy. The barrier is released and the worker joined before checking the result. No wall-clock deadline or native execution timing is inferred.

controls.name: unknown-outcome-mislabeled-committed
controls.oracle: An ambiguous backend result must remain Unknown in the bounded copied worker receipt. The mutation preserves closure/no retry but lies about the outcome. The exact last receipt is checked after a real join.

controls.name: worker-panic-mislabeled-normal-stop
controls.oracle: A caught backend/settings panic must produce a distinct Panicked join disposition. The actual worker has joined before the oracle. The first backend-panic case discriminates this mutation before the second case is created; no detached worker or timeout is accepted.
